docTitle: Bukuit eng’ Ramani · Bukuit eng’ Sirutiet Agenge
metaDesc: Sib sirutietab betusiek nebo Sirutietab Tai, sobetab Jesu, ak bendosiekab Paulo eng’ ramani ne iman — kobwa tuguk che bo Bukuit eng’ olosiek che bo iman.

s.title: Bukuit eng’ Ramani
s.verse: “Amu kima kisub atindonik che kigichobei eng’ ng’omnatet, ye kingemwawok kimnatet ak nyonunetab Kiptaiyandennyo Jesu Kristo, kigi baorinik che kigigeer etunatennyi,” (Petero 2 1:16)
s.purpose: Bukuit ko ma bukutab netetet. Ko sirutiet nebo bik che kikwaite olosiek, betusiek, ak kainaisiek che bo iman. Sib oretinwechoto eng’ ramani, eng’ sirutiet nebo betusiek — nam olondo age, anan iyat ▶ si isib eng’ ng’wan age tugul.
s.ot_h: Kobunu taunet agoi weutet koba Jerusalem
s.ot_lead: Ma bendo agenge kityo, ago ko logoiywetab sorunet kobunu taunet: taunet ak butet → butetab beek ak Babel → kuret (Abraham) → emet ne kiyamgei → Komong’u → tilianik → lutet → bororiet → sulutiet → otwognatet → weutet.
s.je_lead: Sib sobetab Jesu u ye mwae Logoiywetab Kararan, eng’ sirutiet — kobunu siegutennyi eng’ Betlehem, koba baptisiet ak boisiennyi eng’ Galilaya, korumon Samaria, agoi kimurtoiyot, ng’etunet, ak kanyonet barak eng’ Jerusalem.
s.pa_h: Kobunu Antiokia agoi tabandab ng’ony — Roma
s.pa_lead: Kobunu Pentekost eng’ Jerusalem, u ye kibchunei logoiywetab kararan kosir Judea — korumon Asia ne Mining’ ak Ulaya agoi muguleldab bororiet ne o. Lewen bendo agenge eng’ bendosiek mut (ne bo tai · aeng’ · somok + bendo ne koba Roma + eng’ let nebo bolunet) ak isib tuguk che kandoi eng’ Boisionikab Che Kiyoktoi ak barwaisiek che kisirchin eng’ oret.
s.foot: Ole kibunu · Olosiek kosib sirutietab Bukuit ak geografiab Bukuit ne kiyanate (ak kainaisiek che bo ra ye toreti). Kurgetab baret, ainosiek, ak baretenik ko kibunu data ne kayoen nebo ng’ony (Natural Earth), ne kingichobchin komanachot.
